# Sedan Redesign media

Source: [Thermofluids Focused Sedan Redesign](https://ikemenebeli.com/projects/thermofluids), Ikem Enebeli. The existing gallery cover lives one directory above these assets.

The case study figures are saved locally so the gallery and reading view do not depend on a Framer request. The hero and two CAD boards use the source's 2048px variants; the sketches and simulation plots retain their source dimensions and colours.

The coefficient comparison follows the [engineering report](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hJBLUEMNYb1nIfSzz4skYCIBYL9SPhET/view?usp=sharing), pages 13–14. The second iteration uses Cd 0.3462 and Cl 0.0812 from the report rather than the conflicting figures in the source page's mobile markup.
